note: A fold ordering combinator can be an UNGUARDED SEAM while the whole unit battery is green. The Repose: knownness.rs folds events_in to the most recent eruption via .rev; deleting .rev -- earliest-wins instead of latest-wins -- type-checked and left all 11 unit tests PASSING, while moving the answer by up to 0.9989 on 4,644 cell/now samples of seed 42. Only the gate-full committed byte golden objected, an artifact with no named meaning, so the commit gate was blind to a defect in the SOURCE half of a flow balance. Why it hid: every test selected an event with a quiet gap AFTER it and none constrained the window BEFORE it, so two events rarely shared one horizon. TECHNIQUE: when a fold picks ONE element out of a SET, write a test that puts TWO candidates in the set and asserts WHICH one won. A test with one candidate cannot see the selection rule at all -- it passes under every selection rule there is.
